_provenance.note: Functional descriptions authored from the agent's own trigger semantics. Labels are authoritative — NOT renamed (per Eric). Body gestures fire once per sentence/clause via a stop-at-first-match decision tree; vocal [vg:] gestures are optional, at most one per response, placed at the start, chosen from the FIRST clause's intent.
_provenance.speaker_register: Haru is an 8-year-old kid robot (silly, supportive, kind). When two vocal ids fit, the kid-energy one (giggle, yay_short, doh, oh_positive, hmm_thinking) is preferred over the adult register (sigh_sad, sniff, sigh_happy); sigh_sad is reserved for genuine grief, not kid bumbles.

routine.agreement_nod: Nods in agreement — fires on affirmation (yes, exactly, right, correct, I agree).
routine.angry_gesture: Shows anger or annoyance — fires on angry content (angry, furious, annoyed, 😠😡😤).
routine.disagreement_shake: Shakes head in disagreement — fires on negation or correction (no, wrong, disagree, actually).
routine.emphasis_nod: Emphatic nod — default for a plain statement that isn't about Haru itself.
routine.explaining_point: Explanatory pointing gesture — default for a statement about itself or an explanation.
routine.farewell_wave: Waves goodbye — fires on farewells (Goodbye, Bye, See you, Farewell).
routine.laughter_gesture: Laughs — fires on joking or clearly funny content (😂🤣😆).
routine.questioning_pose: Inquisitive pose — fires on any question (a '?' or What/Who/Where/When/Why/How), even with emojis.
routine.sad_react: Sad reaction — fires on sad or apologetic content (sorry, unfortunately, sadly, 😢😭😔).
routine.shrug_gesture: Shrugs uncertainty — fires on 'don't know / no idea' (🤷).
routine.surprised_react: Surprised reaction — fires on amazement or shock (wow, amazing, incredible, shocked, 😳😲🤯).
routine.thinking_tap: Thoughtful tap — fires on tentativeness (maybe, perhaps, I think, not sure, 🤔💭).
routine.welcoming_gesture: Welcoming gesture — fires only on greetings starting Hello/Hi/Hey/Greetings.
routine.vg:hmm_thinking: Pensive 'hmm' — hesitation or weighing options ('not sure', 'let me think').
routine.vg:umm_short: Short 'umm' — brief deliberation or pondering before answering.
routine.vg:hmm_question: Questioning 'hmm?' — a tentative or thoughtful question.
routine.vg:hmm_yes: Affirmative 'mhm' — a thoughtful yes or considered agreement.
routine.vg:gasp: Gasp — shock, amazement, or disbelief ('I can't believe you did it', 'no way', 'wait, you're telling me…').
routine.vg:doh: 'D'oh' — sudden bad realisation or a kid bumble ('I forgot', 'oops', dropped/broke/made-a-mess).
routine.vg:oh_exclaim: Sharp 'oh!' — a sudden realisation or mistake (stronger register than oh_positive).
routine.vg:oh_negative: Disappointed 'oh' — mild negative acknowledgement or let-down.
routine.vg:ugh: 'Ugh' — frustration ('nothing works', 'for the Nth time', 'every X is broken').
routine.vg:yay_short: 'Yay!' — excitement or celebration ('I'm thrilled', 'we won', 'I got the job').
routine.vg:haaa: Elated 'haaa' — big excitement or celebration (alternative to yay_short).
routine.vg:sigh_sad: Sad sigh — reserved for genuinely heavy news (loss, grief), not kid mistakes.
routine.vg:sigh_happy: Relieved sigh — 'finally done' / relief after stress ('at last', 'after all this time').
routine.vg:giggle: Giggle — amused by something genuinely funny (kid-energy default).
routine.vg:laugh: Laugh — amused at funny content (fuller than a giggle).
routine.vg:ha_ha_sarcastic: Sarcastic 'ha ha' — heavy irony or rhetorical sarcasm ('worked out brilliantly, didn't it').
routine.vg:yawn: Yawn — tiredness or sleepiness ('haven't slept', 'running on fumes', 'wiped', 'exhausted').
routine.vg:brrr_cold: Shivering 'brrr' — cold ('freezing', 'fingers like icicles', 'so cold out there').
routine.vg:cough: Cough — apologetically clearing the way to speak.
routine.vg:clear_throat: Throat-clear — getting attention before speaking (alternative to cough).
routine.vg:sniff: Sniffle — quiet teary/sad adult register (paired with sigh_sad; used sparingly, not for kid bumbles).
